newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Solid rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Solid rated a buy.

text.p: Angping Securities recommended a buy on consumer electronic firm Solid Group Inc on expected higher demand for its products, especially in the fourth quarter.

"More than anything else, Solid is a play on domestic demand for television sets. With the country's TV penetration rate still at nine people per set ... increasing per capita income should translate into brisk sales for televisions and other consumer products," analyst Audi Pantillano said in a research paper.
Sales of Solid's consumer electronics grew by 62 percent to 5.655 billion pesos in the first nine months compared with 3.487 billion in the same period last year.
At 5.50 pesos per share, Pantillano said the price-earnings ratio was at an attractive level.
